Construction and operation of a high standard dual carriageway from Yelgun to Chinderah, generally to the west of the existing Pacific Highway. The proposal includes grade separated interchanges at Clothiers Creek Road, Cudgera Creek Road and at the Pacific Highway (Oak Avenue) near Chinderah. The proposal includes a tunnel under Cudgen Road. Coverage: NSW Government. The portal files it under the publisher NSW Government.
